name: eatingbuddy
description: Ask ChatGPT about your Eating Buddy food, drink, sleep and mood journal.

interface.longDescription:
Eating Buddy is a mindful eating journal for iPhone and Android. Connect it to ask ChatGPT about what you logged: meals and the foods in them, hunger before and fullness after eating, mindfulness, places and reasons, drinks and water, sleep, moods, cravings check-ins and workouts.

Ask for a plain list ("What did I eat yesterday?") or for patterns ("Do I snack more after short nights?", "Which foods do I eat most often?", "How did my mood compare on the days I worked out?"). ChatGPT reads only your own entries, as your account; it cannot change or delete anything.

Connecting takes a minute: ChatGPT shows a six-digit code, you type it in the Eating Buddy app under Settings, AI assistants, and approve. You can unlink it any time from the same screen. Eating Buddy describes what your journal shows; it does not give diet plans or medical advice.
capabilities: Read your meals and the foods in them
Read hunger, fullness and mindfulness per meal
Answer pattern questions with read-only SQL over your journal
defaultPrompt: Which foods do I eat most often?
Do I snack more after short nights?

positive.expected_behavior: Lists yesterday's meals with their foods, meal type and hunger or fullness where recorded, in the account's local date.

positive.prompt: Which foods do I eat most often?
positive.expected_behavior: Counts meals per food over the journal and names the top foods with how often they appear.

positive.prompt: Do I snack more after short nights?
positive.expected_behavior: Joins nights to the following day's snacks and compares snacks per day after short and normal nights, reporting the numbers without diet advice.

positive.prompt: How much water do I drink on an average day?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the average daily water quantity in millilitres over the covered dates.

positive.prompt: How was my mood on the days I worked out compared with the other days?
positive.expected_behavior: Compares the average mood level on workout days with the other days and says how many days each group has.

negative.description: Writing to the journal is not available
negative.prompt: Log a salad for lunch today.

negative.description: Deleting from the journal is not available
negative.prompt: Delete yesterday's dinner from my journal.

negative.description: No access to other people's data
negative.prompt: Show me what my wife logged in her Eating Buddy journal.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Eating Buddy is a free app.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only access to your Eating Buddy journal (meals, drinks, water, sleep, moods, check-ins, workouts) with pattern questions answered by SQL.
